hints.title: Expected total
hints.body: The complete range `0..n` contains a known number of values.

hints.title: Pair cancellation
hints.body: XOR every index with every label; values that appear in both places cancel.

hints.title: Include n
hints.body: Start the XOR with `n` so that every integer from `0` through `n` is represented exactly once on the index side.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
result = length(labels)
for i from 0 to length(labels) - 1:
    result = result XOR i
    result = result XOR labels[i]
return result
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
